title: What The Voice Knows — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 100bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal music philosophy Spanish French language learning family
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The voice is the one instrument that everyone is born with
Whether they use it well is a different conversation worth
Having — but the potential is distributed equally
The voice doesn't require a budget or a teacher or a fee

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
La voz es el único instrumento con el que todos nacemos
[The voice is the only instrument everyone is born with]
Si la usamos bien es otra conversación que tendremos
[Whether we use it well is another conversation we will have]
El potencial está distribuido igualmente entre todos
[The potential is distributed equally among everyone]
La voz no requiere presupuesto ni modos
[The voice requires no budget nor modes]

[Chorus — English]
What does the voice know that I don't know?
It knows the signature of the person before the words flow
What does the voice know before it says a thing?
It knows the territory of the room before it's had its sing
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
La voix est le seul instrument avec lequel tout le monde naît
[The voice is the only instrument everyone is born with]
Si on l'utilise bien est une question de ce qu'on fait
[Whether we use it well is a question of what we do]
Le potentiel est distribué également entre toutes les personnes
[The potential is distributed equally among all people]
La voix ne nécessite ni budget ni personnes
[The voice requires neither budget nor people]

[Outro — All three languages]
What the voice knows… Lo que sabe la voz… Ce que sait la voix
The person is in the sound — La persona está en el sonido — La personne est dans le son
That's my boy
